# Verifiable

Medical credentialing and provider network service.

## About

### Founded

2020

### Headquarters

Austin, Texas

### Industry

Healthcare

### Company Description

Verifiable is an API-first, provider network management platform built to help healthcare provider and payer organizations speed up network operations, save costs and streamline the provider experience. Verifiable industry-leading provider data infrastructure connects to thousands of primary sources to deliver real-time provider verification & monitoring to automate the credentialing process - resulting 78% faster turnaround times and millions in added revenue capture.

### Quick Links

[Website](https://verifiable.com/) [Jobs](https://jobs.lever.co/verifiable)

## Funding

### Total Raised

$47 million

### Valuation

Undisclosed

### Significant Investors

Craft Ventures, Highland Capital Partners, 137 Ventures, Cooley, The Altman Fund, Struck Capital, Tiger Global Management

## Company Traction

- As of July 2023, Verifiable has performed 13 million unique primary source verifications and has 3,200+ automated primary source verification types available.

- As of July 2023, Verifiable monitors 300,000+ providers.

- As of July 2023, Verifiable has hundreds of customers, including Babylon, Spring Health, Grow Therapy, Lyra, Zeel, Cityblock, Marvin, Modern Health, and Ophelia.

- From July 2022 to July 2023, Verifiable reported [3x](https://techcrunch.com/2023/07/10/verifiable-healthcare-credentialing-software-27m/) revenue growth and 2x customer growth.

## Leadership Team

- [Nick Macario](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nickmacario/): Co-Founder & CEO of Verifiable. Former Co-Founder & CEO of Remote.

- [Vivekanand Rajkumar](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vivrajkumar/): Co-Founder & CTO of Verifiable. Former CTO at MaidSafe.

- [Rehan Mirza](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rmirza2/): Chief Growth Officer at Verifiable. Former Senior Director of Product Marketing at Zenefits.

- [Lucas Iannaccone](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lucas-iannaccone/): Head of Product at Verifiable. Former Director of Product Development at SeekMedicare.

- [Janan Dave](https://www.linkedin.com/in/janan-dave-38112455/): VP of Operations at Verifiable. Former Head of Patient Operations at Tomorrow Health.

- [Ryan Basch](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ryanbasch/): VP of Sales at Verifiable. Former Senior Director of Enterprise, Mid-Market, and SMB Sales at Modern Health.
